items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Wingy talked the rest of the date.

ctx.x: You told me once that Wingy Manone was like the recording director...

Well, it was his date! It was his date. And we made these two tunes, and they came out so good, he talked the rest of the date. So we still were supposed to do two more tunes. Never got a chance to do 'em. Heh-heh. Another ...(?)... right? Yeah, I had many of those things. That's right! Yeah, Wingy talked the rest of the date. That was a nice date, too.
